create or alter procedure [dbo].[GetPageInformation] @assetUid uniqueidentifier, @rid int as begin declare @breadcrumbsRaw table ([Level] int, [TypeName] nvarchar(500), [Name] nvarchar(max), [TypeUrl] nvarchar(2500), [Url] nvarchar(2500));
insert into @breadcrumbsRaw select * from dbo.GetAssetBreadcrumbs(@assetUid)
select distinct O.[Uid], O.ObjectID as ID, O.ID as AssetID, O.AssetTypeID, OD.DisplayValue, T.Name as [TypeName], T.Class, T.Uid as AssetTypeUid, case when Dash.[Count] > 0 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as HasDashboards, case when Work.[Count] > 0 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as HasWorkflow, case when Child.[Count] > 0 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as HasChildArtifacts, case when Hier.[Count] > 0 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as AllowPredicateHierarchies, ( select * from ( select P.ID as [ID], P.Name as [Name] from [Predicate] P where exists( SELECT * FROM IntersectType IT WHERE P.[type] = 6 and P.ID = IT.PredicateID and (IT.SubjectAssetTypeID = T.ID OR IT.ObjectAssetTypeID = T.ID) ) union select P.ID as [ID], P.Name as [Name] from [NymRelation] R inner join [dbo].[predicate] P on P.ID = R.PredicateID where R.[Object] = T.Object and R.ObjectID = T.ObjectID ) NMT for json path ) as NymTypes, ( select * from @breadcrumbsRaw for json path ) as Breadcrumbs from Asset O inner join AssetType T on T.ID = O.AssetTypeID left join AssetDisplayValue OD on OD.AssetID = O.ID
cross apply ( select count(1) as [Count] from Report where [Location] = 1 and AssetTypeID = T.ID ) Dash cross apply ( select count(1) as [Count] from workflow.EventRegistration WER inner join workflow.Type WT on WER.TypeID = WT.ID and WT.PublishedVersionID is not null and WT.[State] = 1 and WER.ChangeType = 8 where WER.Object = T.Object and WER.ObjectID = T.ObjectID ) Work cross apply ( select count(1) as [Count] from [PredicateIntersect] where SubjectAssetID = O.ID and PredicateType = 3 ) Child cross apply ( select count(1) as [Count] from IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.[Type] = 3 where (IT.SubjectAssetTypeID = T.ID OR IT.ObjectAssetTypeID = T.ID) ) Hier where O.Uid = @assetUid and not exists (select 1 from ResponsibilityDetail where PermissionsBitMask & 1 = 0 and ResourceID = @rid and ( (AssetID = O.ID) OR (AssetTypeID = O.AssetTypeID and AssetID = 0))) and ( t.DefaultPermissions = 1 or ( t.DefaultPermissions = 0 and exists (select 1 from ResponsibilityDetail where PermissionsBitMask & 1 = 1 and ResourceID = @rid and ( (AssetID = O.ID) OR (AssetTypeID = O.AssetTypeID and AssetID = 0))) ) ) for json path, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER end
